workday.name: Workday
workday.title: SpotSign AI vs Workday

workday.summary: While Workday excels at corporate financial consolidation and heavy white-collar HR administration, enterprises struggle with its massive multi-million dollar implementation cycles, lack of native shift/piece-rate floor support, rigid reporting, and bolt-on add-ons. SpotSign AI delivers an agile enterprise platform connecting People, Work, Money, Operations, and Insights out of the box.

keyDifferences.desc: Workday relies on add-on tools and custom extensions built on a legacy platform. SpotSign AI runs workflow automation natively inside daily attendance, ATS screening, attrition risk reporting, and payroll auditing.

keyDifferences.title: Dual Workforce Support (Desk + Floor & Shifts)
keyDifferences.desc: Workday requires expensive third-party bolt-ons for biometric factory timeclocks, maritime STCW logs, and piece-rate tallies. SpotSign AI natively supports corporate monthly staff alongside 3-shift plant workers and field staff.

keyDifferences.desc: Workday reports historical headcount and budget snapshots. SpotSign AI's Workforce Planning allows C-suite executives to simulate restructurings, severance liability reserves, and P&L impacts before committing.
